notes.title: The second playtest starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/0613c19e32657dc5530f5ff5dc7dd6797cffe904.png[/img]
[i]Dear Chefs,[/i]

We are happy to announce that we are conducting another playtest starting from today, May 1st! If you missed the previous one, it is your chance to try Abra-Cooking-Dabra before it’s out.

[b]How to access the playtest?[/b]
It’s easy! Just go over to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021530/AbraCookingDabra/]Abra-Cooking-Dabra[/url] Steam page and press a button.

[b]What has changed compared to the first playtest?[/b]
[list]
[*] The content and the number of missions are the same - this is so players can feel the difference between the two versions more easily.
[*] Added some UX improvements.
[*] Difficulty has been slightly increased (time for completing orders has been lowered).
[*] Localisation was updated.
[*] BEEEEEAAAANNNNS! recipe was updated.
[*] Multiple technical fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]Have fun, and as always, we’ll be waiting for your feedback!

[i]Yours, the Door 407 dev team[/i]

notes.title: Playtest start!
Welcome to Abra-Cooking-Dabra!
notes.content:
Greetings!

Today we present you [b]Abra-Cooking-Dabra[/b] — a cozy craft & cooking card game with puzzle and management elements. Unleash your culinary talents!

Imagine finding yourself in a wonderland… But in the company of an obnoxious talking cat. Threatened to be executed for destroying (totally by accident!) an old recipe book — an essential artifact for the upcoming Royal feast. Now you have no other option but to cook and restore the lost recipes of eldritch British cuisine, serving food to various guests and bosses who play various tricks to mess with you. 

The cooking process in the game is simple. Get an order, get ingredients, and try to cook the dish ordered. Should be easy peasy. Or not. Build and manage your cooking deck of cards, upgrade utensils, farm fresh ingredients and manage your cooking nicely to please picky guests. Every guest gives a hint of what ingredients to use in the dish they ordered, but figure out how to cook them yourself - and dishes get more complicated as you progress through levels. 

So, [b]what[/b] exactly awaits you in the game?
[list]
[*] 30+ game levels to master
[*] 100+ outstanding recipes 
[*] 10+ various guests
[*] 20+ ingredients to farm 
[*] 1 nasty cat[/list]
And most importantly, [b]when[/b]?

We plan to release the game in [b]Q2 2025[/b].

Wishlist the game so you don’t miss dinner time! Join our social media and follow our news!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021530

We’ll return with desserts of news about the game!

[i]Yours, the Door 407 dev team[/i]
